0022600128.text: The Celtics (2-1, 2-0 at home) come into this game on a two-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and 5th in the East, with Devin Carter out due to illness. The Nets (0-3) are on a three-game losing streak, 5th in the Atlantic and 2.5 games back, and 14th in the East, with Tyler Bilodeau out due to a shoulder sprain. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 148-111 win in Boston on February 27, 2026.
